title: Summer Sweet Escape | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Summer Sweet Escape — a house in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. 12 guests · 5 bedrooms · 4.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to 'The Summer Sweet Escape', your perfect WaterColor retreat where spacious comfort meets effortless coastal living.Nestled within the highly sought-after WaterColor community, this beautifully designed five-bedroom home is the ideal gathering place for families and friends, offering plenty of room to relax while embracing the laid-back charm of 30A. Featuring two king ensuites, two additional king bedrooms, and a fun-filled bunk room, every guest will have their own comfortable space to unwind after a day of adventure.Inside, the bright and open living spaces are designed for making memories together. Whether you're enjoying a leisurely breakfast before heading to the beach, sharing meals around the dining table, or settling into the inviting living room after a day in the sun, every detail has been thoughtfully curated for comfort and connection. Coastal-inspired décor, abundant natural light, and warm finishes create an atmosphere that feels both welcoming and relaxing. Step outside to enjoy the fresh Gulf breeze, perfect for quiet mornings with coffee or peaceful evenings spent planning another unforgettable day on 30A.As a guest of The Summer Sweet Escape, you'll enjoy full access to WaterColor's premier amenities, including the renowned WaterColor Beach Club, resort-style pools, private beach access, scenic nature trails, parks, and beautifully maintained gathering spaces that make this community one of the most desirable destinations along the Emerald Coast.Exploring the area couldn't be easier with a complimentary golf cart and adult bikes included with your stay. Cruise to the beach, ride the miles of scenic bike paths, explore neighboring Seaside, or enjoy the exceptional shopping, dining, and entertainment that make WaterColor and 30A so unforgettable.Whether you're planning a family vacation, a couples' getaway, or a trip with friends, The Summer Sweet Escape offers the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and coastal charm. From beach days and bike rides to evenings spent together under the stars, every moment here is designed to create lasting memories.Unpack, unwind, and let the rhythm of WaterColor take over.ImportantAllergy Notice: This home is maintained as a pet-free property because the homeowner has a severe allergy to animal dander. While we comply with policies regarding service animals, guests traveling with a service animal are kindly asked to notify us before arrival so we can take any additional cleaning precautions possible. Please note that we cannot guarantee the home will remain free of animal allergens following a stay with a service animal.HOME HIGHLIGHTSWaterColor Beach Club & Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12)Golf Cart6 Adult BikesFully Equipped Gourmet KitchenSmart TVsFull Sized Washer & DryerBeach EssentialsOutdoor Shower5 Minute Walk to Watercolor Beach Club5 Minute Walk to Camp WaterColorPickle Ball & Tennis CourtsClose to Grayton state Park & Access to the Coastal Dune Lakes (Great for Kayaking & Yolo Boarding) Access to Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside DiningEasy Access to Parks & Walking PathsNearby State Parks & PreservesParking for 1 VehicleGas GrillACCOMMODATIONSThe Summer Sweet Escape Sleeps: 12FIRST FLOORKitchen-Dining-Living-Laundry-Half BathroomBedroom #1: King with EnsuiteSECOND FLOORSecond Floor Living Room with Sleeper SofaBedroom #2: King with EnsuiteBedroom #3: Twin/Twin Bunk BedHall BathroomBedroom #4: KingJack and Jill BathroomBedroom #5: KingPRIVATE BEACH & RESORT ACCESSThe WaterColor Beach Club is the only beachfront clubhouse pool available to rental guests along 30A. It is the ultimate amenity with three pools, expanded seating on upper and lower decks, and lounge areas. The Beach Club has several food and beverage options onsite, towel service, and a charming mercantile with sundries for your pool day. With unobstructed and panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, relaxation and pleasure await you at the Beach Club. Visit the WaterColor Beach Club page for facility hours, lounge chair etiquette, restaurant information, and rules. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.NEARBY PUBLIC BEACH ACCESSRay's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar.Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips.WHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGOne parking spaces available. No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only.Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and driver's license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost.GUEST ACCESSThe WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community.The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an adults only pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf!Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for younger kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground.OTHER THINGS TO NOTEBeach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance.Per Watercolor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands max.In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking, which you will receive a prompted email prior to your arrival. The HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here.The WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration a minimum of 1 week prior to arrival.Regarding the WaterColor pools, until water temperatures are consistently warm enough on their own, WaterColor's pools are maintained around 82 degrees.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*This home is allotted 12 wristbands max per HOA.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*To help us prepare the home appropriately for all guests, please notify us before your stay if you will be traveling with a service animal.*This home must remain pet free.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
